domains.lint-coverage: does every lint rule still catch its bad fixture, and does every good figure still pass?
domains.determinism: does the same spec still give byte-identical SVGs, three builds in a row?
domains.measurement: does every glyph used in the figure corpus have a measured width, or is it falling back?
domains.freshness: do the committed example figures still match their specs?

eval.rubric: evals/run.py: L1 structural (examples build, lint clean, byte-identical pass^3, committed examples current) and L2 golden tasks (evals/golden.json: each bad fixture flagged with exactly its rule, F1 1.0), plus an MCP round trip; blocking in .github/workflows/ci.yml on every push and pull request

externalIntelligence.note: the loop reads only this repository and the figures it is pointed at

proposals.where: an issue titled 'svgforge loop: proposals', plus the proposals artifact of each run
proposals.who_merges: a person; the loop never commits and never merges ('ship' means a person merges a validated proposal)
